TECH-MAP.excerpt:
# Visitor map

Nearby Stories uses MapLibre GL JS with OpenFreeMap's Liberty vector basemap, derived from OpenStreetMap data. No Google Maps API or map API key is needed. The browser fetches the style, vector tiles, fonts and sprites from OpenFreeMap; it no longer requests the standard `tile.openstreetmap.org` raster endpoint. OpenFreeMap's public instance has no SLA or personalized support guarantee.

## Visitor flow

1. Choose a language on first launch, then press Allow location. GPS is not started before that action. HTTPS is required outside localhost.
2. After a location fix, Nearby lists places within 100 m. Open Map to explore.
3. The map shows a labelled real/simulated position, a 100 m circle and the **100 nearest** published narration markers around the visitor (within 50 km), wherever the camera is. Markers outside the circle are outlined and announced as "More than 100 m away". Tap a marker for its preview. Distances are straight-line distances from the visitor, not the map center or walking distances.
4. **Listening is limited to 100 m.** Play narration appears only when the visitor is within 100 m of the place; otherwise the preview and the story page show "Come within 100 m to listen" and the story can still be read. This applies to every way of reaching a story, including name search, and with no location at all. A track that is already loaded keeps playing and stays controllable when the visitor walks out of range; the limit only blocks starting a new one.
5. Play narration stays on the map. Selecting another marker does not change the playing track. View story opens the existing story page; Back returns to the remembered map view and selection. Audio stays mounted across navigation.
6. Pan/zoom never reloads places. The list is loaded around the visitor's position: after 100 m of movement an **Update places** button appears, and after 500 m the nearest places reload automatically. Changing the demo spot recenters and reloads. When more than 100 places are in range, the map says it is showing the 100 nearest.

Denied GPS stays on the permission guidance screen. A lost signal after a fix retains the last position with a warning; playback continues. Inaccurate fixes display a warning; the 100 m listening check uses the reported position as-is, without widening for accuracy. The check runs in the visitor app only: the story and audio endpoints do not receive the visitor's location, so it is a product rule, not an access control. Language fallback/generation is managed at the application root, so an active track's request continues when browsing other pins or returning to the map. Merely previewing a pin on the map does not start language generation.

TECH-OBS.excerpt:
## Part 2: connected traces and processing time

Catalog now stores the current request's W3C `traceparent` and `tracestate` with
each outbox event, inside the same transaction as the publish/retry changes.
Only trace context is captured: arbitrary HTTP headers and baggage are not
stored. A retry request captures its own new parent, while a later dispatch
attempt of the same row continues using that row's original parent.

`AddOutboxTraceContext` adds nullable `trace_parent` (`varchar(55)`) and
`trace_state` (`varchar(512)`) columns. Catalog already runs migrations during
startup, so restarting a rebuilt Catalog applies this addition. Existing rows
remain valid and start a new trace if no usable context exists. The migration
does not replace the outbox table or modify existing event payloads.

TECH-CI.excerpt:
## Workflow selection

Five backend workflows validate pull requests targeting `main` and matching
pushes to `main`. Push and PR path filters are identical within each workflow.
An ordinary push to a feature branch does not run these workflows until a PR
exists. The frontend retains its separate `web` workflow.

| Changed path | Backend workflows |
|---|---|
| `src/Gateway/**`, `tests/Gateway.Tests/**` | Gateway |
| `src/Identity/**`, `tests/Identity.Tests/**` | Identity |
| `src/Catalog/**`, `tests/Catalog.Tests/**` | Catalog |
| `src/Localization/**`, `tests/Localization.Tests/**` | Localization |
| `src/Speech/**`, `tests/Speech.Tests/**` | Speech |
